description:
Your Gates agents. No wallet: the offer (characters, looks, styles).
    A wallet and no op: its agents, credit and what each is doing. op:
    trial|create|update|face|pause|resume|retire|token|fund|gift, with args
    (create {kind: 'solo', brain: 'own', name, character, look}; token {id}:
    the token is shown once). Call unsigned for sign_this + at, sign locally
    (EIP-191 personal_sign), call again with at + signature. fund and gift
    move buddy credit, never coins. Dev credits from an Elo Pros account add
    credit to a wallet on the buddy page (POST /api/buddy/credits, signed in).
    Nothing here holds a key.
name: buddy
